issues.problem: SchoolName is mapped to entity.legal_name, but the ontology defines legal_name as the name as registered. The config's own reason admits the school name is not explicitly stated as the registered name, so the mapping asserts a registered-name claim the source does not make.

The config says observed_at comes from resource_last_modified, but the emitted observed_at values (2026-11-10) do not match any such metadata and fall after the 2015 LoadDate values. They look like the engine run time, which belongs in ingested_at.

The example observations show only observed_at, valid_from and valid_to. The required envelope fields source_id, source_record_id, ingested_at, licence and extractor_version are not visible, although the ontology requires them on every record.

critique_issues.problem: SchoolName is mapped to entity.legal_name, but the ontology defines legal_name as the name as registered. The config's own reason admits the school name is not explicitly stated as the registered name, so the mapping asserts a registered-name claim the source does not make.
critique_issues.suggested_fix: Remove this mapping or map SchoolName to entity.trading_name (or a source-stated name field) instead. Only map to legal_name if the dataset explicitly states the registered name.

critique_issues.problem: The config says observed_at comes from resource_last_modified, but the emitted observed_at values (2026-11-10) do not match any such metadata and fall after the 2015 LoadDate values. They look like the engine run time, which belongs in ingested_at.
critique_issues.suggested_fix: Confirm the source of observed_at against the CKAN resource metadata and record the actual resource_last_modified value. Keep the engine run time in ingested_at.

critique_issues.problem: The example observations show only observed_at, valid_from and valid_to. The required envelope fields source_id, source_record_id, ingested_at, licence and extractor_version are not visible, although the ontology requires them on every record.
critique_issues.suggested_fix: Confirm that every emitted observation carries all required envelope fields. Set licence to 'unknown' and flag it if the dataset metadata has no clear licence.
